title: Set model mocks instead of deleting attributes during force rebuild
answers: Why does concurrent BaseModel.model_rebuild(force=True) cause race conditions with model instantiation?
How to reset core schema, validator, and serializer during model rebuild without breaking thread safety?
How do I invalidate a BaseModel without delattr race conditions in free-threaded builds?
body:
Symptom: Instantiating a model while another thread runs model_rebuild(force=True) resolves uncompleted parent attributes or fails due to missing schema attributes.
Root cause: pydantic/main.py:BaseModel.model_rebuild used delattr on core schema, validator, and serializer attributes, exposing an incomplete unmocked window where concurrent readers fall back to parent class definitions.
Fix pattern: Call _mock_val_ser.set_model_mocks(cls) on already complete models rather than deleting attributes via delattr.
Constraints: Applies when invalidating or rebuilding existing models (when already_complete is True); initial model construction handles mock initialization through the metaclass.
applies: BaseModel schema rebuilding under concurrent or free-threaded execution.
